findings.issue: SHARED VIEW BROKEN: the batch130 value generator's --check failed ('missing unselected source plan') after this packet bound facets into the same 7.8 catalogue and rewrote the view.
findings.resolution: The shared view now composes deterministically through the batch130 renderer, which was narrowly changed to recognise and subtract validated array_constructor_form_ bindings instead of truncating foreign content. Its own fixtures, bindings, ELIGIBLE partition and unknown-facet validation are unchanged; both generators' --check pass in either order.

findings.issue: Six runtime fixtures had EMPTY mutation lists.
findings.resolution: Conforming feature mutations added for every runtime fixture, with a permanent --check-mutations mode; 28 mutants fail on both toolchains.

notes: The inline integer type-spec form left pending is rejected by BOTH toolchains, so it is not an LFortran-only withholding.
